positions.commentary: The speaker questions why IBM would take the risk of investing in new plant and equipment or new business lines when it can instead deliver earnings growth through financial mechanics like stock buybacks and dividends.

thesis: This episode argues that IBM's current strategy of relying on financial mechanics like stock buybacks and dividends to drive earnings growth is risky, as it avoids the necessary investment in new plant, equipment, or business lines.
